summary: Digg's story search and pipeline status are not live endpoints: search and sync run on the paginated /api/feed/continuous story feed (cursor-walked per section, stored locally with per-section freshness), the section list and page paths are whatever digg.com currently serves, and any view Digg drops fails closed instead of returning empty data.
reason: In October 2026 Digg removed /api/search/stories (404) and /api/trending/status (404), renamed its sections (ai, tech, world-business, sports, science, gaming, entertainment, all), and moved the rankings and GitHub pages under /tech, dropping the Emerging and Movers ranking views. The old CLI silently served stale local rows as current search results and failed every sync, which zeroed out downstream research tools. A regen must re-discover the live feed shape (no query or page-size parameter, 20 stories per page, strict 400 on unknown params) rather than assume a search API exists.
validated_outcome: Live 2026-10-21: sync of all eight sections at one page each finished in 6s with titled stories per section; a full ai 30d walk stored 2,400 stories reaching 30 days back in about 2 minutes; search on a fresh store answered in 0.7s and a stale two-section search with live top-up in 8s.
